name: binutils-x86-64-linux-gnu
description: Real amd64 GNU binutils 2.40 executables for ARM64 QEMU user translation qualification.
license: Upstream licenses included in usr/share/doc/*/copyright (GPL, LGPL, BSD, MIT and others)
notes: Deliberately x86-only executable payload on an ARM64 host. Invoke /opt/gizmoth/x86_64/usr/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu-as explicitly; prependPath is empty so native as/ld stay selected. GizMoth registers binfmt_misc and sets QEMU_LD_PREFIX for compatibility checks.
